Title: Store and organization both have records — the organization's logo, preset, menu and footer win per field (read-only over the seeded org)
Preconditions:
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
[PRE:SIGNIN_AS:WL_USER_ELECTRONICS]
No writes, so no exclusive window. State is asserted from the live records in the first steps: store {{STORE_ID}} record enabled with its own logo and preset; organization @td(WL_ELECTRONICS.name) (platform id @td(WL_ELECTRONICS_PLATFORM_ID.id), NOT the CSV key behind @td(WL_ELECTRONICS.id)) enabled with logo, preset, main-menu and footer lists. The organization FAVICON half is an open product question (KB-D4EEDC37) and is not asserted here; the preset is compared through <html data-preset> and against the guest page's colour, never with a literal colour and never with a preset file (theme 2.63.0 bundles the presets and requests none)
Steps:
[AUTH] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (grant_type=password) with the admin account to obtain a Bearer token
[HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/white-labeling/store/{{store_id}} - [CAPTURE] isEnabled as STORE_ENABLED, logoUrl as STORE_LOGO, themePresetName as STORE_PRESET
[HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/white-labeling/organization/{{org_id}} - [CAPTURE] isEnabled as ORG_ENABLED, logoUrl as ORG_LOGO, themePresetName as ORG_PRESET
[ASSERT] STORE_ENABLED and ORG_ENABLED are true and ORG_LOGO differs from STORE_LOGO
[ASSERT] ORG_PRESET lower-cased with spaces replaced by "-" differs from STORE_PRESET normalised the same way (otherwise BLOCKED:CONDITION_NOT_MET: the data could not tell the organization's preset from the store's)
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/graphql whiteLabelingSettings(organizationId: "{{org_id}}", storeId: "{{store_id}}", cultureName: "en-US") { logoUrl themePresetName footerLinks { title childItems { title } } mainMenuLinks { title childItems { title } } } - [CAPTURE] answer as ORG_ANSWER
[NAV] open {{FRONT_URL}} in a fresh browser context
[WAIT] the guest home page renders
[ASSERT] note the computed --color-primary-500 on :root as GUEST_PRIMARY and <html data-preset> as GUEST_PRESET
[ACT] click 'Sign in'
[WAIT] the sign-in form is visible
[ACT] sign in as @td(WL_USER_ELECTRONICS.email) (credentials from the PRE:SIGNIN_AS cluster)
[WAIT] the signed-in home page renders with the account menu
[ASSERT] the header, the main menu and the footer are rendered
Assertions:
[REL] the header logo src path ends with the path of ORG_LOGO and not with the path of STORE_LOGO
[REL] GUEST_PRESET equals STORE_PRESET normalised (a guest sees the store's preset)
[REL] <html data-preset> after sign-in equals ORG_PRESET lower-cased with spaces replaced by "-" and differs from STORE_PRESET normalised the same way (the organization preset, not the store preset)
[REL] the computed --color-primary-500 on :root differs from GUEST_PRIMARY
[REL] the set of top-level header menu titles equals the set of titles in ORG_ANSWER.mainMenuLinks
[REL] the footer section headers equal the titles in ORG_ANSWER.footerLinks
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[CONSOLE] no uncaught JS errors
[NETWORK] the logo image loads with HTTP 200
[API] xAPI errors[] empty
Failure_Signals: the store logo or preset shows for the member; the menu or footer is the store's; the organization key used instead of the GUID (reads as store branding)

Title: An unresolvable theme preset name falls to the theme's bundled default preset — not to the store's preset
Preconditions:
[EXCLUSIVE:white-labeling record of organization @td(WL_DEFAULT.name)]
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
[PRE:SIGNIN_AS:WL_USER_DEFAULT]
NEEDS A STAND WRITE (NEEDS_WINDOW): the record of organization @td(WL_DEFAULT.name) gets themePresetName set to a name that is neither bundled in the theme nor served under /assets/presets/ ("Mercury" IS bundled — it is the store's preset and resolves, so it cannot be the test value). Nothing validates the name (KB-7EF291B3). The bundled default is the `current` entry of the theme's settings_data.json and the resolved file name lands in <html data-preset>. The store preset differs from the bundled default (Mercury vs default), so the two readings of "fallback" are distinguishable
Steps:
[AUTH] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (grant_type=password) with the admin account to obtain a Bearer token
[HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/white-labeling/organization/{{org_id}} - [CAPTURE] the whole record as BEFORE
[HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/white-labeling/store/{{store_id}} - [CAPTURE] themePresetName as STORE_PRESET
[HTTP] GET {{FRONT_URL}}/assets/presets/{{bad_preset}}.json - [CAPTURE] status as BAD_STATUS
[NAV] open {{FRONT_URL}} in a fresh guest context
[WAIT] the guest home page renders
[ASSERT] note <html data-preset> as GUEST_PRESET (absent => BLOCKED:CONDITION_NOT_MET: design classic writes no data-preset, KB-5D6746FB) and the computed --color-primary-500 on :root as GUEST_PRIMARY
[ASSERT] GUEST_PRESET equals STORE_PRESET lower-cased with spaces replaced by "-" (a guest sees the store's preset) and STORE_PRESET differs from the theme's fallback preset, the `current` entry named in References (otherwise BLOCKED:CONDITION_NOT_MET: the store's preset could not be told from the fallback)
[HTTP] PUT {{BACK_URL}}/api/white-labeling with the BEFORE record (same id, same organizationId, isEnabled true) and themePresetName set to {{bad_preset}}
[WAIT] the PUT returns 204
[NAV] open {{FRONT_URL}} in a fresh browser context
[ACT] click 'Sign in'
[WAIT] the sign-in form is visible
[ACT] sign in as @td(WL_USER_DEFAULT.email) (credentials from the PRE:SIGNIN_AS cluster)
[WAIT] the signed-in home page renders with the account menu
[ASSERT] the home page is rendered
[ASSERT] note <html data-preset> as MEMBER_PRESET and the computed --color-primary-500 on :root as MEMBER_PRIMARY
Assertions:
[SHAPE] BAD_STATUS is 404 (the test value is not served, so the fallback path is really taken)
[REL] MEMBER_PRESET is the theme's own fallback preset (the `current` entry of its settings_data.json, named in References as a source note), observed as: it differs from {{bad_preset}} lower-cased with spaces replaced by "-" (the unresolvable name is not echoed, the fallback path is taken) and differs from GUEST_PRESET (the store's preset is not the fallback)
[SHAPE] MEMBER_PRIMARY is a non-empty colour (the fallback palette applies); it is NOT used to tell the fallback from the store's preset, because two bundled presets can share primary-500 (the store's Mercury and the fallback do in vc-frontend@2.63.0), so MEMBER_PRESET is the only discriminator and no relation between MEMBER_PRIMARY and GUEST_PRIMARY is asserted
[SHAPE] the page renders with styles (no "Missing preset" error page)
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[CONSOLE] a warning "Failed to load preset" is allowed, an uncaught error is not
[NETWORK] no 5xx
Failure_Signals: the storefront throws "Missing preset"; data-preset equals the store's preset (wrong fallback); data-preset equals the bad name
Cleanup: PUT {{BACK_URL}}/api/white-labeling with the BEFORE record (same id) so themePresetName is restored; GET it and confirm themePresetName = BEFORE.themePresetName
References: C391195 VCST-1634 · Behavior:wl.render.theme-preset.unresolvable-falls-to-bundled-default · Audited: 2026-11-27 (TCA-2026-11-27); Source: vc-frontend@2.63.0 useThemeContext.ts (addPresetToThemeContext, getThemeConfig().current) + module (no preset validation); Docs: PlatformUserGuide white-labeling managing-themes; KB-7EF291B3 · Synced: qa-suite-sync wl (2026-11-27); fallback preset name = the `current` entry of vc-frontend@2.63.0 client-app/config/settings_data.json ("default"), read at source (useThemeContext.ts addPresetToThemeContext), a source note and not a runtime step; KB-1C18DC2F · Round 3 2026-11-27: preset oracle by relation
